correctness.rationale: The CDF-power mass is positive and telescopes to total probability 1. Strict monotonicity of each normalized positive-index mass in b proves uniqueness of the 0-versus-2 crossing. The attached Python standard-library checker certifies 28 integer-power enclosure comparisons using a rational artanh-series enclosure for log(25/21), establishing both transition bracketing and finite rival inequalities. Since log(25/21)>1/6, the real interpolated CDF is strictly concave for x>=4, and raising to exponent 0<b<1 preserves strict concavity; hence every remaining tail mass is smaller than p5. Local modal skip follows by strict-gap continuity. This is an actual infinite-support proof, not a finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The finding shows two separated global maximizers and a discontinuous skipped intermediate mode under infinitesimal shape variation in an established two-parameter count law. This is an exact, directly interpretable modal phase phenomenon with practical consequences for expected modal behavior and avoiding unjustified unimodality/log-concavity assumptions. A complete all-parameter classification is not claimed or needed for the meaningful counterexample and transition.
